lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters organized into three primary horizontal rows, beginning posterior to the fifth gill slit and extending toward the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of circular clusters to form a regular grid-like pattern of anchor nodes on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper half of the flank, exhibiting a distinct vertical gradient where the dorsal edge of each ridge is high-luminance and the ventral edge is in shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct, high-contrast linear features (remoras) located adjacent to the ventral boundary of the primary pectoral fin.
